exemplary_projects.literal_legend: Projets incités à viser l'exemplarité énergétique (sur base des projets connus - non exhaustif). Réseau thermique de quartier potentiel.
exemplary_projects.meaning: Known project locations encouraged to pursue exemplary energy performance; potential district heat network opportunities, explicitly non-exhaustive.

source_evidence.133: New buildings and renovations should be exemplary; new district projects should aim at recognised sustainable-neighbourhood labels.
source_evidence.134: E1 encourages recognised labels for important new projects, mutualisation and energy-source mix; regulatory implementation remains within municipal competence.
source_evidence.136: Small district thermal networks develop according to opportunities; individual renewable systems remain alternatives.
source_evidence.137: E3.5 facilitates groups of owners for common heat production where no thermal network is nearby.
source_evidence.139: Green patch dotted boundary identifies incentive/potential category, not committed or operational service.

not_claimed: Approved construction project or new building rights
Operational heating network or guaranteed connection/service
Built footprint or legal project perimeter

hydro.literal_legend: Turbinage des eaux de la Veveyse
hydro.meaning: Hydroelectric-development strategy represented by a symbol and route; source does not certify current operation or precise plant/conduit extent.

source_evidence.137: E4 calls for development of a Veveyse turbine plant and facilitation of project implementation.
source_evidence.138: E4.6 use water networks and Veveyse with communes/SIGE; E4.8 study additional potential downstream of Toveires culvert.

geometry_rules: Retain genuine native line geometry and style only; no stroke buffer or infrastructure-width interpretation.
Lightning glyph is a cartographic location symbol, not a plant area; no parcel association inferred.
No artificial connecting of glyph components or route gaps.

photovoltaic.meaning: Municipal strategic encouragement across buildings/infrastructure, with specific heritage-protection reservation; not automatic permission or present installed solar capacity.

thermal_context.meaning: CAD-Gilamont names an existing network strategy with extensions; new networks and potential extensions remain separate planning categories. Blurred colour zones are preferred heat-supply strategies, not exact service boundaries.
thermal_context.alternatives: Existing buildings unsuitable for network connection and new construction within CAD-Gilamont zone are encouraged toward individual renewable systems.
thermal_context.no_legal_advice: Source references LVLEne conditionally; do not infer a current parcel-level legal duty from thematic map.

geometry_limits: Whole original supports only within independently validated page139 frame/hull and Vevey scope.
No inherited page67/87 matrix without new page-specific evidence.
No extrapolating blurred fills or hatch envelopes into hard boundaries.
Discrete green original closed native polygon may describe thematic project support, not parcel ownership or rights.

partial_scope.held_reason: Raw whole support68468 extends outside Vevey; no municipal clipping or threshold relaxation.
partial_scope.native_pdf_clipping: Apply source PDF native per-object clips as required rendering semantics; preserve raw operators, native clip, visible geometry and exact removed area. Tiny source clip cuts are genuine rendering instructions, not geometry errors.
partial_scope.raw_geographic_gates: Raw whole support must remain inside frozen training hull and Vevey before evaluating visible support; never clip to hull or commune.
partial_scope.contextual_parcel_overlaps_only_if_indep: No service availability, development approval, connection duty or parcel rights inferred.

approval_review.title: Vevey — Plan directeur communal V6 du 22 août 2024, approuvé 2 octobre 2024

signed_approval.scope: Signed whole municipal PDCom. Territorial project objectives, principles and measures guide municipal implementation; not every historical diagnosis or population/capacity estimate is a current binding private right.
signed_approval.version_note: Signature sheet footer differs from main version; this distinction is preserved. Exact officially published signed PDF hash is verified; no rewritten or substituted source.

approval_review.diagnostic_vintage_limit: PDF11 explains capacity evaluation made2020/2021 from draft zoning revisions and existing built surfaces; horizon2040 projections and diagnostic data must retain their source dates, not treated as current parcel rights or remaining unbuilt capacity.
limits: Approved municipal main source distinct from regional Rivelac plans or former1997 PDCom.
Original signature PDF149 is image-only for native-text extraction; visual approval evidence is separate, not an OCR transcript.
Cover22Aug2024 and approval-sheet footer2Apr2024 remain distinguishable; approval date2Oct2024 is visually stamped and independently corroborated.
Source project objectives/principles/measures PDF43 do not turn diagnostic estimates, proposed zoning or development horizons into current construction rights.
No geometry qualification, parcel intersections, full-text completeness or commune completion is asserted; all empty/native-text gaps remain auditable.

currentness_evidence.finding: Municipal synthesis confirms council1February2024/canton2October2024 and entry into force.
